content: Jesusanka, bula Zacchaeusanka.
Jana Jesus towndurr Jerichomundurr dungan-dungarin.
Nyubun dingkar yinyaymba bundandan, nyulu maja bamanka Governmentamu tax money mujal-mujan. Nyulu burri Zacchaeus, money jirray bajaku, rich-bala.
Nyulu dingkar kulka bajaku, kari kalbali. Yinyaynka nyulu Jesus kari nyajin, bama wubul bajaku.
Jana bama dungan-dungarin, nyulu Zacchaeus jakalba warrin, jukungu yalbaymba dakan, jukumun Jesus nyajinka bada-bada dungan-dunganya.
Nyulu Jesus bada-bada jukungu kadan, nyulu yala wangkar nyajin, Zacchaeusanda yalaman, “Yundu jukumun jinbalku wala, ngayu yunuwunbu bayanba bundanka.”
Nyulu Zacchaeus jinbalku jukumun jalaman, Jesus wawurr-wawurrduku bayanba walay-manin.
Jana bamangka bulanin nyajin dunganya, jana kuli-kadarin Jesusanka. Jana yalaman, “Wanyurrinku nyulu Jesus yinyarrinyanji bamanji buyunji bundanka?”

Bula bayanba kadan, balkawan. Zacchaeus dakan, yalaman, “Yundu milka-janay, Maja. Ngayu ngayku money, yamba-yamba dajiwanka bamanji money-karinji. Ngayu half dajilda jananda. Ngayu nguba money ngakin bamandamun, ngayu jananda jarra jirrayku dajil baja, 4-timesmunku.”
Jesusangka nyungundu yalaman, “Yurra jawun-karra yaluy bayanba bundandari, Godungku yurranga buyun-buyun kidankuda. Yurra Abrahamandamun. Nyulu yalarrku nyuluku mambarrijin Godundu, kari bayjan.
Ngayu bamanga wubulbuku yaba. Ngayu kadan bama buyun ngulkurr-bunganka. Jana nubijin, ngayu jananin warrmba-bunganka baja.”
Kuku moneyka.

Jana Jesus yubaku townbu Jerusalem dungan-dungarin, bama wubul balu Jesus jananka majamal. Jana yalaku wadu-wadu milkabu wukurrin, “Ngana townbu Jerusalem kadari, Jesus ngananga majamal, Godungku nyungu bama ngulkurrduku kujinka.” Yinyaynka Jesusangka jananda yindu story balkan, jananin binal-bunganka.

Nyulu yalaman, “Ngadiku nyubun maja jirray bubungu yinduymbu kala-kalbaymba dunganka. Yinyaymba bubungu kala-kalbaymba jana nyungun maja jirray king-bunganka. Yinyamun nyulu nyunguwunbuku bubunguku kadanka baja, maja-kingmanka nyunguwunkuku bamanka.

Yala, nyulu dunganjiku, nyulu nyungu workingman 10-bala kunjan, jananda wubulbuku 100 dollars dajin. Nyulu jananda yalaman, ‘Ngayu yurranda 10-balanda wubulbuku 100 dollars dajin. Kaki ngayu yaluy kari, yurra ngaykuwundu moneybu yamba-yamba buy-im-bunga, sellim-bunga baja. Yalaku yurra money jirray-bunga ngayku.’ Yinyamun nyulu dunganda.

Jana bama nyunguwunmun bubumun, jana nyungunku wawu-kariman majamanka. Jana bama nyubun kukuji yungan nyungundu jurungu bubungu yinduymbu, maja-bajandaku yalamanka, ‘Nganjin wawu kari yinyaynka majanka. Nganjin wawu kari nyulu nganjinanga kingmanka.’

“Yamba jana maja-bajangkaku nyungun king-bungan, nyunguwunbuku bubunguku yungan baja. Nyulu nyunguwunbuku bubunguku kadan baja, jananin workingman 10-bala kunjan, babajin, ‘Yurra wanjarr money jirray-bungan?’
Nyubunyinja bamangka yalaman, ‘Maja, ngayu yunu 100 dollars jarra yalbay-bungan, 10 times. Yanyu 1000 dollars yunu.’
Kingangka yalaman, ‘Yinya ngulkurrkuda. Yundu ngulkurrku workmalman. Ngayu yunundu money buban dajin, yundu yinya money yalbay-bungan. Yinyaynka ngayu yununin maja-bungal townku 10-balaka.’
Yinduynju workingmanangka yalaman, ‘Maja, ngayu yunu 100 dollars yalbay-bungan, 5 times. Yanyu 500 dollars yunu.’
Nyulu kingangka yalaman, ‘Ngayu yununin maja-bungal townku 5-balaka.’
“Yinduynju workingmanangka kinganda yalaman, ‘Maja, yanyu yunu 100 dollars. Ngayu yinya money yangkijanga kajan, ngakin.
Ngayu binal yundu maja manun-manun kari. Yundu yunu workingman mambarril yaykarr bajaku workmanka, yundu money jirray maninka. Yinyaynka ngayu yinyil yununku.’
Nyulu king kuli-kadan nyungunku. Nyulu yalaman, ‘Yundu majarr bajaku! Yundu binal ngayu bamandamun money manil-manin yinya ngayku kari. Yinya kuku yunundu milkanga kadan!
Yinyaynka yundu yinya money bankmunbu yijarrinyaku. Yinya money bankmunbu wunananyaku, juma-juma money interest jirraymanyaku.’
“Nyulu kingangka bamanda yalaman, ‘Nyungundumun yinya 100 dollars mana, bamanda yinyayanda daya 1000 dollarsmunjirrba.’
Yamba jana bama yinyaymba janjanan kinganda yalaman, ‘Maja, nyulu 1000 dollarsmunjida. Yundu yinduymbu dajinyaku.’
Nyulu kingangka yalaman, ‘Kaki bama ngulkurrku workmal, ngayu nyungundu work jirray dajil. Kaki bama buyunku workmal, ngayu nyungundu work kari dajil baja. Ngayu nyungu work yinduymbu dajil.
Jakalbaku kanbal ngaykunku wawu kari. Jana wawu kari ngayu jananga kingmanka. Jananin yalaymba wundida, yarkinkaku kunida.’”
Jesus townbu Jerusalem kadan, jana nyungun buyay-manin.
Wawu yinyamun kukumun Jesus jakalba dungan, yuba townbu Jerusalem kadan. Yinyaymba jana jawun-karrangka nyungun juru-manin baja.
Jana townbu jambulbu kadarin, burri Bethphage and Bethany. Bula town yinya-bulal yubaku wuburrbu Olivesmunbu. Yinyaymba manjalba Jesusangka jawun jambul jakalba yungan townbu.
Nyulu bulanda yalaman, “Yubal yinyaymba townbu dungarika. Yubal townbu kadari, donkey karrkay nyajil karrabu kajanya. Bama kariku nyunguwunbu mukungu dakan. Yubal donkey walnga, ngaykundu wundi.
Bama nguba yubalanda babaji, ‘Wanyurrinku yubal yinya donkey walngal-walngal?’ Kaki jana babaji, yubal balka, ‘Ngalinya Maja nyungundu dakanka.’”
Bula dungan, donkey karrkay warrmba-bungan, yala Jesusangka bulanda balkan.
Bula donkey walngal-walngan, majangka donkeyndamundu bulanda babajin, “Yubal wanyurrinku nyungun walngal-walngal?”
Bula yalaman nyungundu, “Ngalinyandamundu majangka nyungun wantim-bungal.”
Yinyamun bula donkey Jesusanda wundin. Bula kambi bulanga mukungu ngaran donkeynda. Bula Jesusanda mara dajin, mukungu dakanka.
Nyulu donkeynji dungan-dunganda, bamangka wubulduku jananga kambi baralba jakalba Jesusanda ngaran-ngaran. Jew-warrangka yalaku jananga king yulmbarrin.

Jana yubaku townbu Jerusalem kadarin, baral badamun manjalmun Olivemun jurrkijin. Yinyaymba jana dungan-dungarin, bamangka wubulduku God buyay-maninkuda, thankim-bungan, Jesusangka miracle yalbay balkanya Godundumundu junkurrdu.
Jana yirrkan, “God buyay-mana! Majangka Godungku yunun yungan! Yundu nganjinangakuda king! Wubulduku yununin buyay-mana bubungu, and jiringa!”
Kanbal Pharisee-warra baraldarr janjanan. Jana Jesusanda yalaman, “Maja, yundu bamanda yunuwunbu balka, yunun kari buyay-maninka.”
Jesusangka yalaman jananda, “Ngayu yurranda balkal, kaki jana bama jankamari, yinyarrin kuljikuda kawal yirrkay ngaykunku.”
Jesus banbadin Jerusalem-warranka.
Nyulu Jesus yubaku townbu Jerusalem kadan, nyulu bamanka townku badin, milka-bujarman jananka.
Nyulu yalaman, “Ngayu milka-bujarmalkuda, yurra binal-kariku bundanya ngaykunku. Yurra binal kari Godungku nganya yungan yurranga wawu ngulkurr-bunganka.
Kanbal yurranka wawu kari. Juma jana soldier-soldier kadari, gate yinyarrin townbu wubulku kanbil, yurra nandajikuda kananga.

Jana bama wubulku yarkinkaku kunil, bayan yinyarrin townbu wubulku wayjul. Kulji-kulji bayanka jana wubulku bubungu yilbal. Jana yurranin buyun-damal, yurra God bayjanya. Nyulu yurranga wawu ngulkurr-bunganka, yamba yurra nyungundu kari milka-janan.”
Jesus Godundumunbu bayanba yalbaymba walan.
Yinyamun Jesus Godundumunbu bayanba yalbaymba walan. Yinyaymba kanbalda bamangka junjuy-junjuy dikal-dikal sellim-bungal-bungan. Jesusangka jananin murru-kangan, ngalkalba kangan.
Nyulu jananda yalaman, “Godungku nyunguwunbu kabanba balkan,

content.text: ‘Ngayku bayan yalbay ngaran, ngaykunji balkawanka, praymanijinka.’

content: Yamba yurra walarinka wurrmay-bakamanka, bayan buyun-damanka.” Nyulu yinya kuku balkan, jana bama jurril-bunganya, money jirray maninka.

Wawu kanganyamun, Jesusangka bama binal-bungan Godundumunbu bayanba yalbaymba. Jana maja-maja Godundumunku bayanka, jana teacher-teacher ngadimunku, maja-maja yindu, jana wubulduku Jesus yarkinkaku kuninka.
Yamba jana yinyilmarin nyungun karrbanka, bama wubulku nyungunku wawumanya. Nyulu bama junkaynjaku binal-bungan. Yinyaynka jana maja-maja yinyilmarin nyungun karrbanka.
